w1.blas_thread_note: multi-threaded BLAS makes the sliced-W1 projection reduction order non-deterministic across processes (measured: one run bit-identical, the next off by 6.8e-10 on Endothelial). Single-threaded reproduces the archived cond_w1 floor bit-exactly, twice. Precedent: HVG2K/ENV_LOG_single_thread_mitigation.md

e21.device_note: 本单只有一块 GPU，生成队列要独占它。E21 的自检容差是它自己预先声明的 float32 精度（sigma 2 ulp / MMD^2 1e-6 / SCC 逐位），CPU 路径实测 sigma <=0.66 ulp、SCC 逐位相等、MMD^2 1.5e-7，全部在容差内；自检与打分在**同一次进程**完成。
